statement: Michelle Gantevoort, Duane W. Hamacher, and Savannah Lischick, "Reconstructing the Star Knowledge of Aboriginal Tasmanians," Journal of Astronomical History and Heritage 19(3) (2016): 327-347, attempts a reconstruction of Tasmanian Aboriginal astronomical/cosmological knowledge, explicitly working from fragmentary ethnohistoric records filtered through colonial recorders (including George Augustus Robinson) who frequently did not name their Aboriginal informants. The underlying reconstruction should be treated as MODERATE-confidence scholarly inference given the acknowledged fragmentary, colonially-mediated sourcing — not equivalent evidentiary weight to mainland traditions in this batch with unbroken living transmission and named contemporary informants.
